# Thunderbird Mail Composition Window

## Window Title and Controls
- Title: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- Window controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- Window border: Light gray

## Menu Bar
- Menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help

## Toolbar
- Action buttons: Send, Encrypt, Spelling, Save, Contacts
- Attachment button: "Attach" with dropdown arrow
- Account Settings link: Located in top-right corner

## Email Header Fields
- From field: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>" with dropdown arrow
- To field: Empty text input box
- Cc field: Label with dropdown arrow
- Bcc field: Label with dropdown arrow

## Subject Field
- Empty text input box labeled "Subject"

## Formatting Toolbar
- Body Text dropdown
- Variable Width dropdown
- Font color selector (black square)
- Font size controls: Decrease, Increase
- Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U) buttons
- Alignment options: Left, Center, Right, Justify
- List options: Unordered, Ordered
- Indentation controls: Decrease, Increase
- Blockquote button
- Insert image button
- Emoji button

## Message Body Area
- Large white text area for composing email content
- Text cursor visible in the center of the body area
- Scrollbars visible on the left and right sides

## Desktop Environment
- Left sidebar with application icons: Chrome, Firefox, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software Center, Help, Trash
- System tray in top-right corner: Network, Sound, Power buttons
- Clock and date: "Oct 23 17:49"
- Activities button in top-left corner

## Background Content
- Thunderbird interface visible behind the composition window
- "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation." message with "make a donation" link
- Thunderbird logo (eagle) in bottom-right corner
- "Documentation" link visible
- "Account Settings" link visible
- "Filelink", "Feeds", "Newsgroups" buttons visible
- "End-to-end Encryption" link visible
- "Message filters" link visible

## Status Bar
- "Done" text in bottom-left corner
- "Done" button with icon in bottom-left corner
